Fatality Analysis Reporting SystemAbout · Using this site

About this site

This site describes the Fatality Analysis Reporting System, published by National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), National Center for Statistics and Analysis. It is generated from the repository pdt-fars, which holds metadata built from the publisher's documentation: each variable's label, question text, codes and missing codes, and availability, with corrections and links between releases. Each fact says where it came from.

What it isn't

  • It isn't the publisher's site, and the publisher hasn't reviewed it. The publisher's own page for the dataset is https://www.nhtsa.gov/research-data/fatality-analysis-reporting-system-fars. Where this site and the publisher's documentation differ, the publisher's documentation is the source; the differences this repository knows of are listed as corrections.
  • It doesn't hold the data. The data come from the publisher, or from this repository's data release when the terms allow; see Getting the data.
  • It makes no analysis decisions: which answers count as agreement, which weights or cases to use, or how to recode. Those belong to the projects that use the data.

Terms of use

Publisher's terms
https://www.nhtsa.gov/research-data/fatality-analysis-reporting-system-fars
What they say
The manual's disclaimer says NHTSA distributes it "in the interest of information exchange" and that it "is available to the public"; it states no license or restriction, and FARS is a US government work. nhtsa.gov blocks scripts and headless browsers, so the site itself wasn't read. Allen Downey decided everything may ship.

PublicDataToolkit

The library and the standard that build this site: https://github.com/AllenDowney/PublicDataToolkit. This site was generated by version 0.1.0.

Reporting an error

  • In the publisher's documentation (a wrong label, a missing code, question text that belongs to another item): open an issue at the issue tracker of the repository pdt-fars, with where you found it. This repository records such errors as corrections, with the evidence, and keeps the publisher's original; it also says whether the error was reported to the publisher.
  • In this repository's records (a wrong link, a code classified wrongly, a variable left out): open an issue at the issue tracker of the repository pdt-fars.
  • To the publisher: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), National Center for Statistics and Analysis.
